metadata.title: आदिवासी को विस्थापित करने पर तुली ममता | Deucha Pachami Coal Project:Forced Displacement of Tribals?
metadata.description:
The West Bengal government has repeatedly assured that no land will be forcibly acquired for the Deucha Pachami coal project. However, ground realities tell a different story. Tribals in the region allege that the government is using various tactics to push them out of their land, threatening their homes, livelihoods, and way of life. What is really happening in Deucha Pachami? Is the promise of fair rehabilitation being kept?

Watch this in-depth explainer as we break down the ongoing conflict, the voices of the affected tribal communities, and the larger implications of this controversial project. 

#DeuchaPachami #TribalRights #LandAcquisition
